Their hashes are enforced by tools/compiler_profiles.py on selection and

The default compiler, headers and libraries remain unchanged in Open-BFME-1.
Use '// compiler: vc71-ddk-4035' only with evidence from retail. In particular,
this compiler emits DXTrace's original /GS cookie shape; the 13.10.6030 SP1
compiler adds two EBP XORs and cannot reproduce those bodies.
